overrides.source: OWNER-DECISIONS 412 (2026-10-05): "Connect is 3 but one is sometimes used for parking, though double and even triple parking also happens." The old reversible lanes (ended 2020, decision 405) are ordinary lanes now, so DC's 1 + 1 plus 2 reversible is stale. Three travel lanes each way north of Calvert St NW (38.9235 N) for the classifier and crossing stress; the curb lane is part-time parking, so the Mass Ride's usable width is two lanes on its own side. Double and triple parking is a known hazard, not modelled. 413: K St to Dupont Circle stays LTS 3. 414: the blocks between N St and R St, where the through traffic is in the Dupont underpass, are south of Calvert St and none of them is touched.
